backup.production_rule: One new table public.house_facts (RLS on, no policy, service_role only; 44 seed rows) and one nullable column concierge_threads.verified_until date. No existing data, function or grant changes. Take a fresh backup if this one is more than an hour old at apply time.

forward_verification.name: seeded_44_active_rows
forward_verification.query: select count(*) = 44 and count(*) filter (where tier = 'public') = 30 and count(*) filter (where tier = 'guest') = 5 and count(*) filter (where tier = 'staff') = 9 from public.house_facts where is_active

forward_verification.name: service_role_only
forward_verification.query: select c.relrowsecurity and not exists (select 1 from pg_policies where schemaname = 'public' and tablename = 'house_facts') and not has_table_privilege('anon','public.house_facts','select') and not has_table_privilege('authenticated','public.house_facts','select') and has_table_privilege('service_role','public.house_facts','select') and has_table_privilege('service_role','public.house_facts','insert') from pg_class c where c.oid = 'public.house_facts'::regclass

forward_verification.name: verified_until_is_a_nullable_date
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'concierge_threads' and column_name = 'verified_until' and data_type = 'date' and is_nullable = 'YES')

steps.name: run_compensating_script
steps.action: deploy messenger-concierge, telegram-cassy and telegram-expense from waves 9ef15fc, then apply supabase/rollbacks/20260929_house_facts.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh (drops house_facts and concierge_threads.verified_until; taught facts are lost - read them out first).

feature_flags.name: sql_then_functions
feature_flags.required_state: Apply, then deploy messenger-concierge, telegram-cassy and telegram-expense from waves 2859e3b or later. Deploying first is safe but pointless: the house block reads nothing (house_load_failed logged) and verified_until is only written when the row carries it.
